scanNote:
7-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (48-bet).

Chap yuqorida qora katta harflar 'UNIT 7', ostida TO'Q SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'Profiles'.
O'ng yarmi TO'Q QIZIL-JIGARRANG fonda, yirtiq qog'oz chegarasi bilan.

SURATLAR: yuqorida ko'k formadagi shifokor ayol bemorning qulog'ini tekshirmoqda; o'ngda ko'k formali, stetoskopli, jigarrang sochli shifokor ayol (Dianne Grey) qo'llarini chalishtirib turibdi; pastda oq futbolkadagi ayol afrikalik onalar va bolalar bilan (bir bolaning tepasiga qo'l tekkizmoqda), atrofda olomon.

CHAP USTUN (oq fon):
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) a) 'Underline the correct word in bold.'
   1 'Doctors Without Frontiers' provides emergency health CARE/ATTENTION.
   2 A PATIENT is a person who is ILL/HEALTHY.
   3 A ROUTINE MEDICAL PROBLEM is a MAJOR/COMMON health problem.
   4 If you TREAT patients, you try to CURE/REPAIR them.
   5 A DECADE is 100 YEARS/10 YEARS.
   6 If you IMPROVE something, you MAKE IT BETTER/WORSE.
   b) 'Where should you go if you have these problems - to a hospital, your GP, a dentist, or a chemist?' Nuqtali ro'yxat: a headache, a cold, toothache, the flu, a deep cut on your finger, a serious burn, a sore throat, earache, a tropical disease, a broken bone, a serious illness, stomach ache. Ko'k qiya namuna: 'If you have A HEADACHE, you should go to A CHEMIST.'
2) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the statements, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).' Besh gap katakchalar bilan: 1 34-year-old Dianne Grey was a successful actress. 2 She began to find her job rather boring. 3 'I was treating patients with routine medical problems.' 4 Various armies have been fighting each other in the area for days. 5 She will be leaving Angola next year.

O'NG USTUN (qizil fon):
• To'q sariq 'Reading'.
3) 'Read the text and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.' Besh savol: 1 Where has Dianne Grey been living for the last eight months? 2 Why did she go to Africa? 3 What has 'Doctors Without Frontiers' been doing for people in Angola since 1986? 4 How did Dianne feel when she first went to Angola? 5 How does she feel now about her experience in Angola?
• Sariq sarlavha 'Working with the Sick'. Oq matn, besh xatboshi, qalin so'zlar: organisation, career ahead, equipment, armies, training local people, meaningful experience.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '48'.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
TIBBIYoT LUG'ATI - TA'RIFLAR.

  ⚠ Qiya so'zlar matnda uchraydi;
  bu mashq ularni O'QIShDAN OLDIN
  tushuntiradi.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 health CARE - tibbiy xizmat
  2 a patient is ILL - bemor kasal
  3 a routine problem is COMMON -
    oddiy muammo keng tarqalgan
  4 treat → CURE - davolash =
    sog'aytirish
  5 a decade = 10 YEARS
  6 improve = make it BETTER


⚠ 'DOCTORS WITHOUT FRONTIERS':

  = 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar'
  (Médecins Sans Frontières) -
  xalqaro tibbiy tashkilot.
  ⚠ 'a frontier' = chegara.


⚠ 'HEALTH CARE':

  = tibbiy xizmat, sog'liqni saqlash.
  ⚠ 'care' = g'amxo'rlik, parvarish.
  ⚠ 'attention' = e'tibor - bu
  yerda mos emas.


⚠ 'A PATIENT':

  = bemor (ot).
  ⚠ 'patient' (sifat) = sabrli -
  34-betda bor edi!
  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir xil yoziladi.


⚠ 'ROUTINE':

  = oddiy, kundalik.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ruːˈtiːn/ - urg'u
  oxirida.


⚠ 'TO TREAT' va 'TO CURE':

  treat = davolamoq (jarayon)
  cure = sog'aytirmoq (natija)
  ⚠ 'repair' = ta'mirlamoq -
  faqat NARSAlar uchun!


⚠ 'A DECADE':

  = o'n yillik.
  ⚠ 'a century' = yuz yillik.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈdekeɪd/.


⚠ 'TO IMPROVE':

  = yaxshilamoq.
  ⚠ 'an improvement' - 44-betda.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'health CARE' = tibbiy xizmat - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'attention' = e'tibor.

items.textEn: 2 A patient is a person who is ___.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a patient' = bemor → kasal.
⚠ 'patient' (sifat) = sabrli - boshqa ma'no.

items.textEn: 3 A routine medical problem is a ___ health problem.
4 If you treat patients, you try to ___ them.
6 If you improve something, you make it ___.

exercises.instructionEn: Where should you go if you have these problems - to a hospital, your GP, a dentist, or a chemist?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu muammolar bo'lsa qayerga borish kerak - kasalxonaga, oilaviy shifokorga, tish shifokoriga yoki dorixonaga?
exercises.explanationUz:
KASALLIKLAR VA QAYERGA BORISh.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If you have A HEADACHE, you should
   go to A CHEMIST.'


TO'RT JOY:

  a chemist = dorixona (yengil
     muammolar)
  your GP = oilaviy shifokor
     (o'rtacha muammolar)
  a hospital = kasalxona (jiddiy)
  a dentist = tish shifokori


⚠ 'GP':

  = General Practitioner - umumiy
  amaliyot shifokori (Britaniyada
  oilaviy shifokor).
  ⚠ 'YOUR GP' - har oilaning o'z
  shifokori bor.


⚠ 'A CHEMIST':

  Britaniyada = dorixona (va
  dorishunos).
  ⚠ AQShda 'a pharmacy' /
  'a drugstore'.
  ⚠ 'chemist' o'qilishi /ˈkemɪst/ -
  'ch' → /k/.


⚠ 'ACHE' SO'ZLARI:

  a headache - bosh og'rig'i
  toothache - tish og'rig'i
  earache - quloq og'rig'i
  stomach ache - qorin og'rig'i
  ⚠ 'ache' o'qilishi /eɪk/ - 'eyk'.
  ⚠ 'headache' SANALADIGAN
  ('a headache'), qolganlari odatda
  sanalmaydigan.


⚠ 'A COLD' va 'THE FLU':

  a cold = shamollash ('A' bilan)
  the flu = gripp ('THE' bilan)
  ⚠ 'I have A cold' / 'I have THE
  flu'.


⚠ 'A SORE THROAT':

  = tomoq og'rig'i.
  ⚠ 'sore' = og'riydigan.
  ⚠ 'throat' o'qilishi /θrəʊt/.


⚠ 'A BURN':

  = kuyish.
  ⚠ 'to burn' = yonmoq, kuymoq.


⚠ 'DISEASE' va 'ILLNESS':

  disease = aniq kasallik (tibbiy)
  illness = kasallik holati (umumiy)
  ⚠ 'disease' o'qilishi /dɪˈziːz/.

pairs.right: a headache, a cold, a sore throat, stomach ache
pairs.rightUz: bosh og'rig'i, shamollash, tomoq og'rig'i, qorin og'rig'i
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Yengil muammolar - dori sotib olish kifoya.
⚠ Kitobdagi namuna: 'headache → chemist'.

pairs.right: the flu, earache, a tropical disease
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Shifokor ko'rigi kerak, lekin shoshilinch emas.
⚠ 'GP' = General Practitioner.

pairs.right: a deep cut on your finger, a serious burn, a broken bone, a serious illness
pairs.rightUz: barmoqdagi chuqur kesik, jiddiy kuyish, singan suyak, jiddiy kasallik

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  If you have [muammo], you should
  go to [joy].

⚠ 0-tur shart gapi + 'should'
(maslahat).
exercises.exampleEn: If you have a headache, you should go to a chemist.
modelAnswers: If you have a headache, you should go to a chemist.
If you have toothache, you should go to a dentist.
If you have the flu, you should go to your GP.
If you have a broken bone, you should go to a hospital.
If you have a serious burn, you should go to a hospital.
If you have a sore throat, you should go to a chemist.
modelAnswersUz: Tishingiz og'risa, tish shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.
Grippingiz bo'lsa, oilaviy shifokoringizga borishingiz kerak.
Suyagingiz singan bo'lsa, kasalxonaga borishingiz kerak.
Jiddiy kuygan bo'lsangiz, kasalxonaga borishingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar MATNDAN
aniq.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 F - 'a successful DOCTOR'
      (actress EMAS)
  2 T - 'she began to find her job
      rather boring'
  3 T - matnda aynan shu iqtibos
  4 F - 'for DECADES' (days EMAS)
  5 F - 'next MONTH' (year EMAS)


⚠ TUZOQLAR:

  doctor → actress
  decades → days
  month → year
  ⚠ Bir so'z almashtirilgan - diqqat
  bilan solishtiring.

items.sentence: 34-year-old Dianne Grey was a successful actress.
items.uz: 34 yoshli Dianne Grey muvaffaqiyatli aktrisa edi.

items.sentence: She began to find her job rather boring.
items.uz: U ishini ancha zerikarli deb topa boshladi.

items.sentence: "I was treating patients with routine medical problems."
Various armies have been fighting each other in the area for days.
items.uz: Turli armiyalar bu hududda bir necha kun jang qilmoqda.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'for DECADES' - o'n yillar, kunlar
emas.

items.sentence: She will be leaving Angola next year.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ TARJIMASI
bandlarda.


⚠ 7-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - MATNDA:

  PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS:
    'she HAS BEEN LIVING in Angola'
    'HAS BEEN SENDING medical teams'
    'HAVE BEEN FIGHTING'
    'HAS BEEN WORKING hard'
    'HAS BEEN TRAINING'
    'HAVE BEEN HELPING'

  PRESENT PERFECT:
    'HAVE GROWN worse'
    'HAVE BECOME a major problem'
    'HAS TREATED thousands'
    'HAVE NEVER FELT so useful'
    'HAS ALREADY DECIDED'

  ⚠ Keyingi betlarda tushuntiriladi.


⚠ 'THE SICK':

  = kasallar (the + sifat = odamlar
  guruhi).
  ⚠ 'the poor' = kambag'allar,
  'the rich' = boylar.


⚠ 'ANGOLA':

  Afrikaning janubi-g'arbidagi
  davlat. 1975-2002 yillar fuqarolar
  urushi bo'lgan.


⚠ 'HORSHAM, SURREY':

  Horsham - Angliya janubidagi
  shaharcha; Surrey - grafl ik
  (viloyat).

points.en: 34-year-old Dianne Grey was a successful doctor in the south of England, but for the last eight months she has been living in Angola, working for an organisation called Doctors Without Frontiers that provides emergency health care in several African countries.
points.uz: 34 yoshli Dianne Grey Angliya janubida muvaffaqiyatli shifokor edi, lekin so'nggi sakkiz oy davomida u Angolada yashab, bir necha Afrika davlatida shoshilinch tibbiy yordam ko'rsatadigan 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar' tashkilotida ishlamoqda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'FOR the last eight months she HAS BEEN
LIVING' - PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS: boshlangan
va DAVOM ETAYoTGAN ish.
⚠ 'an organisation' - Britaniya imlosi 's'.

points.en: Dianne was a GP in Horsham, Surrey. She had a good career ahead of her and a comfortable life, but she began to find her job rather boring.
points.uz: Dianne Surrey grafligining Horsham shahrida oilaviy shifokor edi. Oldinda yaxshi karyera va qulay hayot bor edi, lekin u ishini ancha zerikarli deb topa boshladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a career AHEAD of her' = oldinda karyera.
⚠ 'to find sth boring' = ... ni zerikarli deb
topmoq.
⚠ 'began' - 'begin' o'tgan zamoni.

points.en: She says, "I was treating patients with routine medical problems - colds, sore throats and so on - and I felt a need to do something more important."
points.uz: U aytadi: "Men oddiy tibbiy muammoli bemorlarni davolardim - shamollash, tomoq og'rig'i va hokazo - va muhimroq narsa qilish zaruratini his qildim".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I WAS TREATING' - PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'and so on' = va hokazo.
⚠ 'to feel a need to' = zarurat sezmoq.

points.en: The organisation she works for has been sending medical teams and equipment to Angola since 1986. Various armies have been fighting each other in the area for decades, and standards of health care have grown worse and worse.
points.uz: U ishlaydigan tashkilot 1986 yildan beri Angolaga tibbiy jamoalar va jihozlar yuborib kelmoqda. Turli armiyalar bu hududda o'n yillar davomida bir-biri bilan jang qilmoqda va tibbiy xizmat darajasi tobora yomonlashgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'SINCE 1986' (boshlanish nuqtasi) va
'FOR decades' (davomiylik).
⚠ 'worse and worse' = tobora yomon.
⚠ 'equipment' - SANALMAYDIGAN.

points.en: Outside the cities there aren't enough hospitals, clinics, doctors or nurses, and many diseases have become a major problem.
points.uz: Shaharlardan tashqarida kasalxona, klinika, shifokor va hamshiralar yetarli emas va ko'p kasalliklar jiddiy muammoga aylangan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'enough' + ot: 'enough hospitals'.
⚠ 'HAVE BECOME' - present perfect: natija hozir.

points.en: At first Dianne was shocked, but she has been working hard to improve conditions there. During her time in Angola, she has treated thousands of patients and has been training local people as health care workers.
points.uz: Avvaliga Dianne hayratda edi, lekin u yerdagi sharoitni yaxshilash uchun qattiq ishlab kelmoqda. Angoladagi vaqti davomida u minglab bemorni davoladi va mahalliy aholini tibbiy xodim sifatida o'qitib kelmoqda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'at first' = avvaliga.
⚠ 'HAS TREATED thousands' (NATIJA - soni) va
'HAS BEEN TRAINING' (JARAYoN - davom etyapti).
⚠ 'to train sb AS' = ... sifatida o'qitmoq.

points.en: "Working here has been a very meaningful experience," she says. "I have never felt so useful before. It's so great to know that we have been helping people who really need it."
points.uz: "Bu yerda ishlash juda ma'noli tajriba bo'ldi, - deydi u. - Men hech qachon o'zimni bunchalik foydali his qilmaganman. Haqiqatan muhtoj odamlarga yordam berib kelayotganimizni bilish juda ajoyib".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I have NEVER felt ... BEFORE' - present
perfect + never.
⚠ 'meaningful' = ma'noli, ahamiyatli.
⚠ 'so useful' = shunchalik foydali.

points.en: She will be leaving Angola next month, but she has already decided to return to Africa as soon as possible.
points.uz: U kelasi oy Angoladan ketadi, lekin imkon qadar tezroq Afrikaga qaytishga allaqachon qaror qilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'will be leaving' - FUTURE CONTINUOUS
(kelishilgan reja).
⚠ 'has ALREADY decided' - present perfect.
⚠ 'as soon as possible' = imkon qadar tez.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL - JAVOBLAR MATNDA.


⚠ SAVOL ZAMONLARI:

  1 'Where HAS she BEEN LIVING?' -
    present perfect continuous
  2 'Why DID she GO?' - past simple
  3 'What HAS ... BEEN DOING?' -
    present perfect continuous
  4 'How DID she FEEL?' - past
    simple
  5 'How DOES she FEEL now?' -
    present simple

  ⚠ Javob ham SAVOL ZAMONIDA
  beriladi.

items.en: 1 Where has Dianne Grey been living for the last eight months?
items.uz: 1 Dianne Grey so'nggi sakkiz oy qayerda yashab kelmoqda?
items.answerEn: She has been living in Angola.

items.en: 2 Why did she go to Africa?
items.answerEn: Because she found her job as a GP rather boring and felt a need to do something more important.
items.answerUz: Chunki u oilaviy shifokorlik ishini zerikarli deb topdi va muhimroq narsa qilish zaruratini his qildi.

items.en: 3 What has 'Doctors Without Frontiers' been doing for people in Angola since 1986?
items.uz: 3 'Chegara bilmas shifokorlar' 1986 yildan beri Angola aholisi uchun nima qilib kelmoqda?
items.answerEn: It has been sending medical teams and equipment to Angola.
items.answerUz: U Angolaga tibbiy jamoalar va jihozlar yuborib kelmoqda.

items.en: 4 How did Dianne feel when she first went to Angola?
items.uz: 4 Dianne Angolaga birinchi borganida o'zini qanday his qildi?

items.en: 5 How does she feel now about her experience in Angola?
items.uz: 5 U hozir Angoladagi tajribasi haqida qanday fikrda?
items.answerEn: She thinks it has been a very meaningful experience and she has never felt so useful before.
items.answerUz: U buni juda ma'noli tajriba deb hisoblaydi va hech qachon o'zini bunchalik foydali his qilmagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then explain the words in bold.

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'ahead of her' = uning oldida.
⚠ 'career' o'qilishi /kəˈrɪə/ - urg'u ikkinchi
bo'g'inda.

⚠ 'meaning' + '-ful' = ma'noga to'la.
⚠ 'experience' bu ma'noda sanaladigan:
'a meaningful experience'.
